title: Update BookmarkCodec's dual-key comment — it describes the pre-Phase-B bug as still live

evidence.quote: // Dual-key: live writers (BookmarkEntity.toFirestore et al.) persist the ref
/// Phase B: routes through [BookmarkCodec.encode] so the write shape is

why: bookmark.dart's own comment confirms Phase B already made BookmarkEntity.toFirestore route through this exact codec, which writes sefaria_ref, not content_item_id. bookmark_codec.dart's comment still describes 'live writers... persist the ref under content_item_id' in the present tense, as if that writer still exists today. A future maintainer reading only this file would wrongly conclude content_item_id is still being actively written and might be reluctant to ever retire the read-side fallback, or misdiagnose which key is canonical.
recommendation: Reword to past tense: 'Pre-Phase-B documents may still carry content_item_id; decode() accepts both for backward-compatible reads.'
acceptance_criteria: Comment reworded to past tense; no behavior change.
